title: #169 Working Women
prompt: More and more women are managing to combine raising a family and following a career. Some people believe this is a challenge for women. Please give your suggestions about this challenge on a personal level and a national level.

promptSegments.text: More and more women are managing to combine raising a family and following a career.
Some people believe this is a challenge for women.
Please give your suggestions about this challenge on a personal level and a national level.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main problem is the traditional separation of roles, making it hard for women to balance family and career.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main problem is the traditional separation of roles, making it hard for women to balance family and career.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution is increasing community and government support to share care duties, making it easier for women to work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution is increasing community and government support to share care duties, making it easier for women to work.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main problem is the unequal division of caregiving tasks at home, which makes it hard for women to balance their jobs and family life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main problem is the unequal division of caregiving tasks at home, which makes it hard for women to balance their jobs and family life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A good solution is for the government to provide better and more affordable childcare services to help working mothers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A good solution is for the government to provide better and more affordable childcare services to help working mothers.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary challenge faced by working women is the unequal distribution of domestic and caregiving responsibilities, which hinders their professional growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary challenge faced by working women is the unequal distribution of domestic and caregiving responsibilities, which hinders their professional growth.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A key solution involves establishing comprehensive national childcare solutions to alleviate the burden on working parents and promote gender equality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A key solution involves establishing comprehensive national childcare solutions to alleviate the burden on working parents and promote gender equality.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the challenges women face in balancing family and career on both personal and national levels, and provide actionable suggestions.
keyArguments: The dual burden of family and career responsibilities places significant stress on women personally.
National policies and societal attitudes play a crucial role in supporting women in balancing these roles.
